primary.title: How does MDR on UPI compare to charges on traditional debit and credit cards? Here's what NCPI's FAQs say…
primary.summary: Is UPI still the most affordable digital payments tool? Today we take a look at what the NCPI's FAQ document states about how merchant discount rate (MDR) charges on UPI transactions compare to fees on traditional debit and credit cards.
